use_cases: Showcasing company history, mission, and values for interior design or architecture firms
Displaying service offerings with animated icons and descriptions for home services businesses
Featuring company statistics and team information on about pages
Creating scroll-driven parallax sections for modern website designs
Building trust through awards and client testimonials for design agencies
ai_summary: A comprehensive company introduction section featuring parallax scroll animations, animated service cards with icons, and statistics that trigger on scroll. The component uses Framer Motion for smooth entrance animations and decorative floating elements, making it ideal for interior design, architecture, or home services companies looking to showcase their expertise and company culture on a modern website.
